# Statement blocks of the rendering head that no test in cmd/dinah executes.
#
# TestEveryStatementOfTheRenderingHeadIsCoveredOrNamed reads this file. Every
# entry is a place the output check does not look, so an entry is a finding
# rather than a line of configuration: it says a block prints for a reader and
# nothing in the suite has ever read what it prints. Two assertions keep the
# pressure on. An entry naming a block the suite does execute fails, so a stale
# entry is pruned rather than left to accumulate, and an entry carrying no
# reason fails, so nobody adds one without saying why the block is unreached.
#
# A line is the block, then whitespace, then the reason. A blank line and a
# line opening with a hash are commentary.
#
# Two kinds of entry sit here and the difference is worth reading. Some blocks
# cannot be reached from a test at all, and say so. The rest are reachable and
# simply unreached: each is a human rendering the suite has never printed, and
# each is worth a test rather than a permanent line here.

commands.go:398.2,399.10  runGuide printing one guide's text, which is reached only by naming a topic; the corpus asks for the topic listing and never for a guide.
help.go:126.32,128.3  verbHelp refusing a command it does not know, which runHelp settles before composing anything, so no invocation reaches it.
render.go:49.29,51.27  the stale outcome of a response, which the cli head cannot provoke: a stale revision needs a second writer between the read and the act.
render.go:51.27,53.4  the same, on the branch where the stale response carries a card.
render.go:54.3,54.102  the same, writing the stale sentence.
render.go:55.10,56.108  the unreachable outcome, which is by construction the outcome no invocation produces.
render.go:65.16,68.3  the branch where the machine form will not marshal, which needs a value the library cannot build.
render.go:98.19,100.3  a token the catalog carries no rendering for, and every token the head prints has one.
render.go:194.29,197.3  the sentence a listing prints when the state holds no card. Reachable and unreached: worth a test.
render.go:291.23,294.3  a card carrying a body, printed under its own line by show. Reachable and unreached: worth a test.
render.go:329.30,330.20  the reason a block carries in the history. Reachable and unreached: worth a test.
render.go:435.23,437.4  the states listing asked for before a workbench is open, which unknown-state cannot be raised before.
render.go:478.18,480.3  the composer's fallback for a refusal name no shape declares, which the source-side guard fails a build over, so no invocation reaches it.
render.go:520.23,522.3  a composition splicing no fragment at all, which needs a shape offering no next step, and every shape offers one.
render.go:548.2,548.11  the alternation answering with nothing, which needs a last member carrying a condition, and the guard fails a shape whose last member does.
table.go:115.30,117.3  the shipped binary's branch, where no test hook is armed. The suite arms the recorder for its whole run, so this is unreachable from a test by construction.
